book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: HEBREOS Hebreos're queti owa cojorica pũuro

content: Paia wiogʉ ca nii earã cõrora, bojoca, cʉ̃ja watoa ca niigʉre beje ami, bojoca yeere Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ca jãi bojapʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yee cʉ̃ja ca jee dica wooriquere Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre tiicojo, bojoca ñañarije cʉ̃ja ca tii wapa tuariquere, waibʉcʉrã jĩari tiicojo ametʉene boja, ca tiiparã cʉ̃ja ca jõenerã niima.
To biri pai majuropeera manire biro ca tʉgoeña bayitigʉ niiri, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yeere ca majitirãre, ñañarije ca tii maa wijiarãre boo paca ĩa majimi.
To biro ca biigʉ niiri ñañarije cʉ̃ ca tiirije wapare, ñucã bojoca yee wapa cãare, waibʉcʉrã jĩari joe mʉene cojo majimi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre, ñañaro cʉ̃ja ca tiiriquere cʉ̃ acobo bojajato ĩigʉ.

Jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peera cʉ̃ majuropeera, “Yʉ, paia wiogʉ yʉ niirucu,” cʉ̃ ca ĩirije jʉori méé, paia wiogʉ niimi. Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, Aarón niiquĩricʉre, paia wiogʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro cʉ̃ ca tiiricarore birora, paia wiorã ca niiparãre bejeri, paia wiorã cʉ̃ja ca niiro tiimi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ.
To biri wãmera Jesucristo cãa, cʉ̃ majuropeera paia Wiogʉ ca nii majuropeegʉ jãatiupi. Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pee, to biro ca biigʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro cʉ̃re tiiupi, o biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiricʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro macã:
Ñucã ape tabepʉ o biro ĩi owarique nii:

content.text: “Mʉa, pai to birora ca niicõa niigʉ mʉ niirucu,
Melquisedec cʉ̃ ca biiquĩricarore birora,” ĩiupi.

content: Jesucristo cʉ̃ ca bii yaipa upʉ mena cʉ̃ ca cati niiri rʉmʉrire, bii yairiquere ca ametʉene majigʉre tutuaro wederique mena, ñucã otirique mena, cʉ̃re jãi juu bueupi. Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pea cʉ̃ ca ĩirore biro ca tii nʉnʉjeegʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro macã, cʉ̃ ca juu buerijere tʉoupi.
Cʉ̃ Macʉ̃ nii pacagʉ, ñañaro cʉ̃ ca tamʉorije mena cʉ̃ ca ĩirore biro tii nʉnʉjeeriquere majiupi.
To biro bii, ca ñañarije manigʉ nii eari, niipetirã cʉ̃re ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerãre to birora caticõa niiriquere ca tiicojogʉ nii eaupi.
Ñucã Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pea Melquisedec're biro paia wiogʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro cʉ̃re tiiupi.
Díámacʉ̃ tʉo nʉcʉ̃ bʉo yerijãarique ca uwiorije nii
Paʉ nii biiropʉa, ate maquẽre wederʉgarique, to ca bii pacaro, yoari méé ca tʉo ñee bayitirã mʉja ca niirije jʉori, do biro pee mʉja ĩi wede majio majiña mani.

Añurije quetire tĩrʉmʉpʉra ca tʉo jʉoricarã niiri, aperãre ca bue majioparã ʉnopʉ mʉja niimi. To biro bii pacarã, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yeere mʉjare cʉ̃ja ca buerique mʉja ca tʉo majipe ʉnopʉrena, “O biro pee ĩirʉgaro ĩi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ wederique,” ĩi wede majio nemoriquepʉ mʉja boocã ñucã. Ca tutuatirã, baariquere ca baatirã, õpẽcõacã wado ca jinirãre biropʉ mʉja biicã yai waajapa.
Õpẽcõacã wado ca ũpũrã, ca ũpũrãacã, “Ate añurije nii, atea ñañarije nii,” ca ĩi majitirãre biro niima.
Baarique ca bayirijepʉa, bʉcʉrã, “Ate añurije nii, atea ñañarije nii,” ca ĩi ĩa beje majirãpʉ cʉ̃ja ca baarije nii.
